vulnerability_cn: 钱包签名秘密值可由公开交易计算，暴露地址签名能力
vulnerability_en: Wallet signature secret derived from public data exposes address signing capability
detail_cn: 官方说明签名中的秘密数值可在特定条件下由公开交易计算，从而推导受影响地址的私钥材料。外部取证将其归因于 Ed25519 签名器漏接秘密 nonce 材料；本轮未独立核对发布二进制、受害源码或逐笔攻击交易。本案例仅保留非合约事件文档证据，不进入 dataset 或 CSV。源表约 1600 万 ADA、200 万美元口径保留在归档中；后续官方约 1610 万 ADA、374 个钱包、260 万美元为另行统计。
detail_en: The official FAQ states that a signature value intended to depend on secret information could instead be computed from public transaction data, exposing affected address private-key material. External forensics attribute this to omitted secret nonce material in the Ed25519 signer; shipped binaries, victim source and individual attack transactions were not independently verified here. This non-contract incident remains documentation evidence only and is excluded from the dataset and CSV indexes. The sheet estimate of about 16M ADA and USD 2M is retained in this archive; the later official figures of about 16.1M ADA, 374 wallets and USD 2.6M are a separate estimate.
source_verification: Official incident FAQ and independent published forensic findings read; RFC 8032 used to explain the general signature relation. No victim signer source imported, no deployed app binary verified, no real private keys derived, no independent transaction replay.
